svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a blank 436 mm wide by 153 mm; cut an 80 mm wide notch 25 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: deep in the middle of one long edge (it clears the down tube).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the 25 mm flanges either side of the notch by 110 degrees,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the guard leans back 20 degrees when the flanges lie flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flanges: four 6.5 mm holes, 80 and 180 mm each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm from the fold (M6 screws into the nose beam's rivet nuts).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round the top corners to 10 mm; deburr all edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the nose beam's top, its fold on the beam's rear edge; its top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge is 120 mm above the beam, over the front end of the belt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 15 mm or more from the belt; 2 mm or more from the front cover.
